input.frequency_authority: applied IF plus nominal 9.750 GHz LNB LO; uncalibrated

interpretation_limits: catalogue candidates are not satellite identifications
observer site is a reviewed preset, not capture-bound GPS
antenna boresight and gain pattern are unknown
constant frequency offsets absorb transmitter, receiver, and LNB offsets
time shift absorbs TLE along-track error, receive-time convention, and clock error
time shift and constant offset are locally confounded for nearly linear Doppler
the wide search is a multiplicity/degeneracy sensitivity, not a clock estimate

method.candidate_set: plausible Starlinks above geometric horizon at any actual-time knot
method.doppler_sign: received-minus-transmitted; receding range rate is negative shift
method.propagation_time_semantics: SGP4 at receive time; no light-time iteration
method.ranking_metric: sample-count-weighted RMS of forward and reverse holdouts
